name: Kazama Ruka
source:
1st year high school student.
A member of the light music club. The guitarist in a popular band around campus.
He's a popular guy who is loved by all the girls in school. He models for magazines as well.
However he isn't good with children or old people.

(CV.Tochihara Rakuto)
